newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end down after three days of gains.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end down after three days of gains.

text.p: * Trading seen sluggish on Tuesday amid selective buying
Manila shares ended its three-day winning streak on Monday as investors cashed in on their gains and set aside money for initial public offerings, traders said.
The main index fell 16.16 points, or 0.50 percent, to 3,210.30 points after Friday's 38.68-point advance.
"The market's correction was expected because of last week's rally," said Jonas Ferrer, research director of Pryce Securities.

Traders said they expected sluggish trading on Tuesday as the ongoing initial public offering of shopping mall owner Ever-Gotesco Resources and Holdings Inc was drawing attention away from the stock market.
Others, however, said bargain-hunters would see any dip in the bourse as a buying opportunity since second quarter gross national product figures are expected to be released next week.
"A GNP figure approximating the first quarter's 6.2 percent will buoy the market," said Pryce's Ferrer.
